description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Table XU (no primary key, a unique (not primary) index on N) with rows (ID, N, G) inserted (5, 3, 1), (2, 7, 2), (8, 1, 1), (1, 6, 2), (7, 4, 1), (3, 8, 2), (6, 2, 1), (4, 5, 2) and s 'r1' to 'r8' in insertion order. Dynasets over the table name, SELECT ID, s FROM XU; SELECT ID, s FROM XU WHERE N >= 3; SELECT ID, s FROM XU WHERE G = 1; SELECT ID, s FROM XU WHERE s <> 'r4'; SELECT ID, s FROM XU WHERE ID > 2; then snapshots of the WHERE N >= 3 and WHERE s <> 'r4' statements as controls. Asks whether an unordered dynaset comes in storage order, primary-key order, or the order of an index on the WHERE column.
